messages:
sara: Quick sync — proposed minor image harden + key rotation next Tue. Need RBAC change for cosign signer and confirmation that audit logs capture key ops. Any immediate concerns?
lee: Which clusters? is this limited to prod or also staging/dedicated?
sara: Staging + prod. Affected: runtime-prod, batch-workers, gpu-pool. We'll do staging first.
nate: Plan looks ok. Important: don't revoke old key until after proof-of-verify on prod. Keep two active versions for 72h.
security-bot: notice: previous RBAC PR had broad role grants to group:builds@redwood.com — recommend scoping to serviceAccount:cosign-signer@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com.
lee: I'll draft the RBAC change: restrict roles/cloudkms.signer to the cosign-signer SA and add a condition limiting resource.name to the cosign key path.
sara: Also please add logging sink: forward KMS admin & data access logs to gs://audit-keystore/rotations. We need AsymmetricSign and Verify entries for forensics.
sre-oncall: Reminder: schedule a 1-hour window for canary with @sre-oncall present. Expect to run smoke tests: `cosign verify`, image pull, and audit query.
nate: Smoke query I'll use: `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName=\"AsymmetricSign\" AND resource.labels.crypto_key_id:cosign" --limit 5`
lee: I'll include a short rollback in the PR: revert deployment annotation to previous image tag and rebind old key if needed.
sara: Cool. PR when ready. If RBAC checks pass and staging canary verifies signatures and logs, we proceed to prod next day. Thanks.
